title: X replaces ‘misaligned’ revenue sharing program with Original Content Rewards | TechCrunch
summary: In announcing the change , the company said it will be winding down its existing Revenue Sharing program and replacing it with something called Original Content Rewards. Then, starting on September 8, they’ll be able to apply for the new program.
